answer: A vine of per-task receipts records who did what, and the zephyr of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. What survives to the knoll is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
